PHAROS maritime route comparison

Network: Eurostat SeaRoute marnet, distributed with searoute 1.6.0.
Network origin: https://github.com/eurostat/searoute
Network license: EUPL-1.2. See LICENSE-EUPL-1.2.txt.
Python reference package: https://github.com/genthalili/searoute-py
Python reference license: Apache-2.0. See LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt.

The JavaScript compatibility engine uses the existing PHAROS searoute-compatible
implementation, tested against Python searoute 1.6.0. The maritime network is
exported without changing its node positions, edge weights or passage labels.
This is an advisory distance/route model, not a ship navigation service.
